notes: Protected attributes are excluded from model inputs.
Director history can carry opportunity-related proxy bias.
The original binary name-based gender analysis is not used here.

limitations: Original training rows were selected by post-release popularity and are not a census.
Nominal historical dollars were not inflation-normalized in this baseline.
Training-time structured rows and embeddings require a corrected successor audit.

Buzz is not an input to this baseline and no hand-authored social multiplier is used.
Secondary revenue targets are unavailable for this baseline.
Synopsis was unavailable; the title alone was encoded and uncertainty was retained.
Production budget was model-imputed at $68,000,000 from pre-cutoff genre comparables.
